state.description: Fold the Hemingway-Red Bluff 230 kV Line into the new Conway 230 kV Switching Station. Construct a 230 kV line approximately 34 miles in length from the Marion 230-115-69kV Substation to the Conway 230 kV Switching Station. Rebuild the existing Marion-Conway 115 kV Line for 230/115 kV double-circuit using bundled 1272 ACSR for the 230 kV line and single 795 ACSR for the 115 kV line.

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?

criteria.true: Same facility: the name matches and the operator, voltage and state are consistent with the project.
criteria.false: A different facility, e.g. a similarly named substation of another utility or in another state or region than the project describes.
